question: Generate a pie chart to show the distribution of cancer grades across all patients.

files.eval_guideline: Pie chart must show proportional slices with percentage labels for each cancer grade; color scheme and font may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The files have identical base names and PNG image formats. Both paths correspond to the requested pie chart showing cancer-grade distribution for task b-3-4.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires semantic visual properties: proportional slices and percentage labels for each cancer grade, while allowing colors and fonts to differ. Semantic comparison is therefore more appropriate than pixel-level matching.

comparison_details.explanation: Both images present a pie chart of the same cancer-grade distribution across 120 patients. The proportions match exactly: Grade I 24.2% (29 patients), Grade II 29.2% (35), Grade III 35.0% (42), and Grade IV 11.7% (14). The candidate adds the sample size to the title and displays counts within the slices, while using different colors, label wording, slice ordering/orientation, borders, and typography. These are noncritical presentation differences; the underlying data, proportional slices, percentage labels, and scientific message are fully equivalent.
